1436 is a leap year (divisible by 4).  
From 1436-10-31, add:  
31 days left in Oct → go to 1436-11-30 (0 days into Nov),  
30 days in Nov → 1436-12-30,  
31 days in Dec → 1437-01-30,  
30 days in Jan → 1437-02-29 (1437 is not leap, divisible by 4 but not by 100? 1437 not leap),  
Wait, 1437 not leap → Feb has 28 days.  

Let’s count systematically:  
Days from 1436-10-31:  
Oct 31 → Nov 1 is 1 day, so 222 days total.  

Better: 222 days = 7 months + some days roughly, but safer to count:  

Remaining days in 1436 after 10-31:  
Nov (30) + Dec (31) = 61 days.  
222 - 61 = 161 days left into 1437.  

1437 is not leap (1437 mod 4 = 1).  
Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30 = 31+28+31+30+31+30 = 181 days from Jan 1 to end Jun.  

161 days into 1437:  
Jan (31) → 130 left,  
Feb (28) → 102 left,  
Mar (31) → 71 left,  
Apr (30) → 41 left,  
May (31) → 10 left.  

So after May 31, 10 more days → June 10, 1437.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1437-06-10
